newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER-PARMA BEAT JUVENTUS TO OPEN UP TITLE RACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PARMA BEAT JUVENTUS TO OPEN UP TITLE RACE.

text.p: Parma threw the Italian title race wide open on Sunday by beating Juventus 1-0 while all the other leading sides won to cut Juve's lead at the top of the table.
Italy striker Mario Chiesa scored the crucial goal for Parma in the second minute of a nerve-ridden violent match in which each side had two players sent off.
It was the second successive suprise victory for Parma, who beat champions Milan just before the Christmas break.
Vicenza, 2-0 home winners over Bologna thanks to two strikes from Uruguay's Marcelo Otero, took sole possession of second place on 26 points, three points behind Juventus.
Veteran captain Roberto Mancini scored a hat-trick in Sampdoria's 5-4 win over Udinese while Internazionale beat Roma 3-1 in Milan.
Sampdoria and Inter are joint third on 25 points, four points behing the world club champions.
Argentine international Gabriel Batistuta missed a penalty but his Fiorentina side still beat Napoli 3-0 at home to move into fifth place on 24 points.
Milan can join them if they beat Lazio at Rome's Olympic Stadium later on Sunday.
